name: Nancy Burdett
fact: The 1972 Talisman spells her two ways in the same volume. The Associated Students group caption on p. 273 has Nancy Burdett, which is the archive's spelling; the junior class grid on p. 354 and the back index both have Burdette, and the index gives her full name as Nancie Lee Burdette. One index entry covers both pages, so they are one person. Flagged, not resolved.

name: Ed Jordon
fact: The 1972 Talisman spells him three ways. The junior class officers caption on p. 352 has Ed Jordon, which is the archive's spelling; the junior class grid on p. 359 prints EDWARD H. JORDAN; the back index files him as Jordan, Edward Harry, Jr., and gives pp. 225, 352 and 359, so all three are one man. He was junior class president in 1971-72, the year before he became president of the Associated Student Government. Page 225 is the Alpha Gamma Rho membership photograph, whose third row the caption reads Greg Beavin, John Tabor, Johnny Connors, Roger Bradford, Jerry Hayden, Ed Jordan, Sam Day and Teddy Self.

src.label: 1972 Talisman, pp. 225, 352 and 359, and back index

name: Dave Luckey
fact: The 1972 Talisman's back index gives his page as 380, which is in the sophomore section, but the junior grid on p. 360 is where DAVID A. LUCKEY is actually printed, and the page image carries the folio 360. The index OCR shatters this run of surnames badly, reading Luckett as Lockett and giving John M. Lucas and Harry Luckett 360 in the same breath, so 380 is a misprint or a misreading of 360. He is the only Luckey in the volume.

name: Carolyn Ragland
fact: The 1972 Talisman spells her both ways. The Associated Students group caption on p. 273 has Carolyn Ragland, which is the archive's spelling; the junior class grid on p. 363 and the back index have Raglin, and the index gives her full name as Carolyn Sue Raglin with pp. 238, 273 and 363. One index entry covers both, and the volume holds no other woman of either spelling. A separate Phyllis Ragland, Pi Kappa Alpha sweetheart, is indexed apart from her at p. 245 and is not the same person.

name: Carl Stolzfus
fact: The Talisman spells him Stoltzfus, with a t, in both the 1972 and 1973 volumes; the archive has Stolzfus. He was a Sigma Nu, and the fraternity's page in the 1973 volume records what he did in student government: 'Brother Carl Stoltzfus is also a member of Associated Student's Government, the student member to the Academic Council.' He and Mike Brandenberg represented the chapter at the National Leadership Methods Convention that year, and he was on the Talisman staff.
